newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala, rebels conclude round of peace talks.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala, rebels conclude round of peace talks.

text.p: Guatemala's government and leftist rebels concluded a three-day round of negotiations in Mexico City on Friday regarding the future of guerrillas once they return to civilian life, the United Nations said.
"The delegations ... concluded their first round of negotiation on the theme of bases for the return of the guerrilla to the nation's political life," the United Nations said in a news release.
Government negotiators and commanders of the Guatemalan National Revolutionary Unit (URNG) plan to conclude sessions on the future of guerrillas by the end of October.
A final peace agreement putting into effect 11 separate accords, most of them already signed, is on track for ratification in December.
